claimed_scope: Build the smallest deterministic, immutable permitted-source Retina fan-in planning boundary for Frankenstein 2.0. It consumes an exact caller-supplied permission snapshot binding opaque source references to explicit CAMERA/SCREEN/PAGE/USER_ACTIVITY source kinds plus capture/cognition/persistence booleans, and an exact fan-in policy with a hard maximum of one through four parallel Retina worker slots. It emits only a deterministic plan of enabled/deferred/denied source references and slot identities; it never opens a camera/screen/page, tracks user activity, spawns threads/processes, invokes Retina/VLM/model/provider/tool/VPS runtime, reads/writes UnifiedDB, authenticates a dashboard/user, infers permission, broadens permission, stores raw sensor data, authorizes effects/completion, or mints perception-runtime/physical-GRID10/GWT/J-Space/training/whole-system credit. Capture permission is the hard gate: cognition or persistence flags can only narrow a captured source and can never self-grant capture. Duplicate/unknown source identities and stale/mismatched snapshot/policy digests fail closed. Source plus deterministic falsification tests and repository-hosted CI only.
